description:
## Problem
benchbox submit, benchbox publish, scripts/stage_seed_corpus_bundle.py, scripts/validate_submission.py and results-data/validate_corpus.py each decide admission and ranking themselves and disagree (T3). Staging treats "not ranked" as "not admitted", so non-standard-scale results never stage. Query-only TPC results have no way into their lane (T2).

## Change
- core/results/submit_classification.py, subscale_policy.py, core/publishing/admission.py, validation bundle.py, both validators and the staging script call the rule and delete their own class conditions. Vendor terms, anonymization, tuning and timing-coverage checks stay, behind the same entry point.
- Public and maintainer admission follow the rule table (owner decisions 1 and 2). Rankings for the 19 stored results change here.
- Parity test: one table of cases run through every path, asserting the same admitted, lane and label.
- Lane canary: for each lane (combined, power-only, throughput, subscale, unranked), build a result through the CLI argument and classification path with a stubbed executor and assert it enters that lane.
- Update results-data/SEED_CORPUS_SPEC.md and CORPUS_NOTES.md.

## Decision gates
- Do not change the behaviour of any symbol the Explorer pipeline imports (for example from subscale_policy.py); the pipeline switches to the rule in crr-b3. Rankings change in validate_corpus.py here and on the public site only at crr-b3, after crr-b2 has put the labels in place. If a pipeline output changes in this item, stop: the change is in the wrong item.
- The hosted ingest is out of scope (see crr-00): if it disagrees with the rule, stop and report.
- If validate-submission-parity-rejects-bundle-paths-20261117 is still open, read it first; if it blocks the mirror, record that on crr-a5.

## Guardrails (apply to every item of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix. Only the pvm-p* items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file to make it pass. Outcomes change only through the rule.
- Any change to the outcome of a stored result must show in the committed outcome snapshot diff in the same pull request and be explained in its body.
- No new stored class value. No reader may decide anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- Paths, line numbers and counts in this plan were read on 2026-11-22 at develop 93f3360. Re-read before editing; report drift, do not guess.
- AGENTS.md applies: linked worktree, one pull request per item, close at the merged pull request, heavy work only through make heavy-run, no live cloud run without owner approval in that task.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded default. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner. Never substitute a different owner decision.
- Read crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan first: it holds the owner decisions, the rule table and the fault types (T1 to T5).
